content: AI music assistant / DAW copilot competitive landscape (2025-2026). Three categories: (1) Generation plugins — LANDR Composer (formerly Orb Producer Suite): AI chord progression generator, smart MIDI for chords/bass/melodies/arp, humanization modifiers (polyphony, swing, strum), scenes+song mode, drag-and-drop MIDI to DAW, 100+ preset sounds; Scaler 3: chord progression workstation, scale/key detection, voice leading, melody suggestion, integrated Carbon Electra 2 synth, Scaler Detector for key detection from audio/MIDI; Captain Plugins Epic: 5 connected plugins (Captain Chords/Melody/Deep/Beat/Play), workspaces for song sections (verse/chorus), magic buttons, sync to DAW timeline, humanize (Space/Strum/Swing), Roman numerals genre filtering, MIDI export, Phase Plant presets. (2) Mastering/stems — LANDR Mastering Plugin, Moises, RipX (stem separation). (3) Generation-only clouds — AIVA, Soundful, Mubert, CassetteAI. Critical gap: ALL are plugin-in-DAW generators or cloud SaaS; NONE do analysis of existing user material, NONE do patch/diff reversible editing, NONE maintain project memory, NONE are local-first copilots with a CLI contract. This validates bw-brain's differentiation.
